prototype_note: In a production NariCare app, users would sign in via secure federated login such as Google, Apple, or Amazon. This PartyRock prototype demonstrates the AI-powered health navigation engine.

onboarding.title: Begin Your NariCare Journey
onboarding.description: Fill in your preferences below to begin your NariCare journey.

fields.label: What would you like help with today
Describe Your Health Concern
fields.placeholder: Describe what you have been noticing in your own words. You do not need medical terminology.
fields.example: My periods have been irregular for 3 months and I feel very tired.
fields.why: Your description helps NariCare provide relevant health-navigation information. We ask only what is needed.

fields.label: How Long Have You Noticed This
